customManagers.description: The pinned gitleaks release the CI history scan downloads
The Renovate release the config validator in CI runs; it moves on Renovate majors only (packageRules).

packageRules.description: Patch, minor and digest updates merge themselves once the branch is green and up to date with main, after the 3-day minimumReleaseAge, as in tycstation's shared preset. Majors stay PRs. platformAutomerge is off: main has no branch protection and the repository does not allow auto-merge, so Renovate merges a green, up-to-date branch itself.

The validator pin moves on Renovate majors only: a PR per Renovate release moved the number and never changed the validator's verdict. A renovate.json that needs a newer option bumps the pin in the same PR.
CI tests on the python the PVE 9 hosts run (Debian 13 ships 3.13); a newer line in CI would pass what the hosts cannot run.
